utfall: i arbeid i oppfølgingstiden (31 studier; 48,8 % mot 28,3 %)
sitat: A higher percentage of IPS participants (48.8%) than control group participants (28.3%) were employed during follow-up, showing small effect sizes (OR = 2.62 [2.37–2.89], p < 0.01).
IPS participants were longer employed than those in the control group during follow-up, showing small effect sizes (d = 0.41 [0.30–0.52], p < 0.01).
IPS participants earned more wages during the study period than those in the control group, though effect sizes were small (d = 0.31 [0.19–0.44], p < 0.01).
